title: Golden Deer Comparison
prompt:
Claude shifts his weight casually near the stone archway and gives a small knowing smile toward Byleth. Background Golden Deer students continue quiet conversation. The movement should feel relaxed but observant, as if Claude is testing the new teacher without saying much.

Camera: slight lateral drift, relaxed handheld stability.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. For war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful; show pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. Avoid: comic exaggeration, broad waving, modern charm gestures. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; for war phase students, keep them early-20s and beautiful, showing war pressure through costume, posture, lighting and setting, not through aging.
